mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 70 degrees and fair at Fireman's Park. Tonight, look to the skies as the ISS will be visible for two minutes starting at 6:34 PM, traveling from over Cross Plains toward the Madison area near Home Depot.
The Verona Plan Commission is reviewing project proposals for the Liberty Business Park, while city officials have also posted official notices for the upcoming elections.
There is plenty to do with Yoga at Insight Wellness happening today, followed by a full schedule of trivia and live music beginning tomorrow at local venues like Hop Haus and Paddy Mac's.
In a report from the Verona Police Department, officers arrested a man for O W I on October 25th after discovering a vehicle stopped at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's flavor is Chocolate Volcano. The restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:00 PM.
